$comment: Service settings per Vite mode (docs/PLAN.md, section 10). Empty mcpUrl, loginDomain and webClientId mean demo only. `production` holds the public values of the production service: an address, a login domain and a public client id, none of them a secret. `development` stays empty in the repository: local values are not committed. Modes not listed (for example `test` or `demo`) are demo only. `cloudflare` (the Cloudflare Pages build) holds the public values of the open service's production deployment (docs/PLAN.md, section 18, "Abrir producción"): `access` public, the pages.dev address as redirectUri and logoutUri, and its mcpUrl, loginDomain, webClientId and Turnstile site key, none of them a secret. Optional `access`: `invitation` (the default when absent) or `public` for the open service (docs/PLAN.md, section 18), which also needs `turnstileSiteKey`, the public site key of Cloudflare Turnstile.
